title: [IMP2-18] Broadcast `seq` is counted per `kid`, which every device of a `did:key` poster shares
description: Review finding IMP2-18: Broadcast `seq` is counted per `kid`, which every device of a `did:key` poster shares (lens IMP2). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:200. Fix: As described. Per the did:key decision memo, devices copy the identity key. Add a per-device value to the `BroadcastMessage` body, for example the device's leaf signature key, which is already unique per device under the did:key decision, and count `seq` per (`kid`, device). Full text: notes/review2/IMP2-verified.md and notes/review2/IMP2.md.
